metadata.description: YapCut by alexmuresan.com: a measured-first short-form content engine for Claude Code. Outlier Radar interviews a creator once (audience, proof, voice corpus), then each week reads last week's numbers, finds rising mechanics and writes gated scripts and LinkedIn posts to filming slots on a tracked dashboard. The Lead Magnet Report turns one category's measured data into a comment-gated document post. The TikTok Yap Editor turns raw phone clips into finished vertical video with an edit record that joins the cut to the post.

plugins.name: outlier-radar
plugins.description: Weekly script and post engine for a creator or brand, plus the Lead Magnet Report. 3.11: the brief opens with the scripts the creator approved, cadence gates off by default, one item one subject, a rendered filming pack, a strict dashboard build. Data lives in a local workspace plugin updates never touch.

plugins.name: tiktok-yap-editor
plugins.description: Turn raw phone clips into finished vertical video for TikTok, Reels, Shorts and LinkedIn. 3.9: restarts found in the audio itself, ad-libs accepted at the caption gate, every decision at once and a rerun in seconds, a filming day read once and the clause plan proposed from the script.
